GKK: Who you are and who you know: a key of your own, meeting people, introducing them.
GSG: Friends: become friends by agreeing, and end a friendship.
GnW: Wards: agents a person creates and looks after, who act only through their guardians.
GAI: AI agents with an accountable developer and an accountable owner.
GSNP: Forwarding with provenance: every forward adds a signature you can see.
CSSN: A social network safe for children: parents, kids-only groups, coming of age.
GC: Personal currencies: everyone can issue their own coins.
GB: Bonds with maturity dates, and escrow, on top of coins.
GFF: Feeds and followers, delivered from friend to friend.
AGORA: Barter: make things, post them on a market wall, trade them.
GDO: Pointing: each person points to some of their friends, and to people those friends point to.
